text: {"lessons":["I sold winners in B and D, then later bought them back at higher prices; I’ll avoid selling just to bank a gain and use a consistent thesis-based plan instead.","Selling Stock A at a loss hurt, but holding only to avoid admitting a mistake would not help; I’ll judge it by its prospects now, not my average cost.","Several months passed with no trades, and that was fine; I’ll trade only when a clear change in my view or portfolio needs justifies it."]}
